policy: References informed taxonomy, adult size, fin-form definition, proportions, landmarks and a blue-red colour strategy only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed.

targetForm.name: long-finned single-tail halfmoon blue-red male
targetForm.definition: A domestic male Betta splendens with a nominal 180-degree halfmoon caudal envelope. Morphology and colour are separately triangulated because domestic strains vary widely and no single photograph supplies orthographic side, front and top views.

sources.uncertainty: Hue and saturation are camera-, lighting- and individual-dependent. The source supports broad colour placement only, not exact sampled RGB values.

referenceGradeRationale: Exact lateral, front and top-oblique Betta splendens file pages document the selected landmarks, while an exact blue-red halfmoon page supports qualitative colour placement and the IBC standard defines the caudal envelope. Absolute dimensions still come from FishBase rather than a calibrated specimen. The top and colour photographs are oblique, so width and hue remain explicitly uncertain.
